validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml"
       xmlns:env="https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/namespaces/env"
       version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="s0">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="key"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="s0">
    <onentry>
      <env:get name="API_TOKEN" location="key"/>
    </onentry>
    <transition target="done"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<env:get>` is an element in the `env` namespace, which has none

primary.message: not an element of any vocabulary

notes: `https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/namespaces/env` is an attribute vocabulary only: an invoked service's `<invoke env:<slot>="NAME">` names the variable whose value the host binds to that slot
diagnostics.help: remove the element, and put an `env:<slot>` attribute on the `<invoke>` of the service that needs the value
